title: Failure, Recovery, Retry, Idempotency and Exactly-Once
results: Failure and uncertainty are distinct; timeout/disconnect do not prove non-occurrence.
Delivery, local execution, external Effect and semantic outcome are orthogonal axes.
Recovery, reconciliation, retry, replay, resume and compensation are distinct operations.
Current exact replay is same-Job durable reattachment rather than execution retry.
clientRequestId plus request identity provides durable Runtime admission idempotency and changed meaning conflicts.
Response loss after admission is recovered by same-identity replay rather than new admission.
Idempotency is effect equivalence rather than side-effect freedom or read-only behavior.
Request idempotency does not imply external-effect idempotency.
Current Attempt dispatch is at-most-once because dispatch intent is committed before provider crossing and ambiguous dispatch is not repeated.
At-most-once permits zero realizations and can therefore converge to Lost/unknown.
Current arbitrary execution does not promise at-least-once or exactly-once physical/effect execution.
Process exit success/failure cannot prove arbitrary external Effect success/absence.
Lost is not proof target never ran and Orphaned represents unresolved ownership/identity continuity with conservative capacity retention.
Late identity-bound Runner evidence can supersede conservative uncertainty while history preserves prior evidence.
Reconciliation converges surviving truth and does not retry ambiguous opaque work.
Doctor/repair refuses to guess and requires explicit audited repair when evidence cannot decide.
At-most-once, at-least-once and exactly-once claims must be scope-qualified to an event/effect/owner/failure model.
Reliable transport alone cannot yield exactly-once external Effect semantics.
Exactly-once external Effect requires Effect-owner cooperation such as durable identity/deduplication, commit/preconditions, receipt/query and retention.
Runtime Release is a structured reconcilable Effect with deterministic identity and canonical deployment receipt.
Workspace Patch is a distinct structured Effect with prepared/committed/unknown reconciliation and no blind mixed-state retry.
Two structured Effects validate contract vocabulary but do not make opaque execution idempotent or justify a generic EffectAdapter.
Compensation is a new domain Effect rather than rollback and checkpoint resume differs from retry-from-start.
Current Runtime generic reliability shape is durable idempotent admission plus at-most-once dispatch plus evidence-first reconciliation plus explicit ambiguity rather than generic exactly-once.

nextRound.title: Observation, Evidence, Proof and Truth Surfaces
nextRound.entryQuestion: What makes an observation authoritative evidence for a fact, how do independent truth owners conflict/supersede, and what may Runtime safely claim from receipts, process state, digests, absence and bounded projections?

notes: RF10 explains current failure/recovery/idempotency scope but does not authorize automatic retry, multi-Attempt execution, generic exactly-once, checkpoint/resume, compensation workflows or EffectAdapter changes.
